maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells auto-dimming mirrors and electronics to automakers for new vehicles; aftermarket is small.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are automotive OEMs, aerospace and fire-protection buyers, paid by private businesses and consumers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through own products and design wins; VOXX acquisition is a single large deal.

mission_critical.reason: Mirrors and cameras are qualified into automakers' vehicle platforms over multi-year programs, making switching costly and requalification necessary.
